newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY WEAKER ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY WEAKER ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar extended its losses against the key U.S. dollar on Wednesday and was also quoted easier against other hard currencies after a fairly brisk interbank session.
But dealers said overall the day's foreign currency inflows from exporters matched import outflows.
"We saw some big volumes (of trade) today. There was sort of a balance between inflows and outflows," said one.
He said the local unit finished at 11.0725/0825 against the U.S. dollar, where it was fixed for most of the day, a drop from 11.0700/0800 at Tuesday's close.

On the crosses, it was also quoted weaker on sterling at 17.8770/9035 compared to 17.8700/9100 the previous day and was at 6.5400/5500 from 6.5000/5100 versus the mark. Against South Africa's rand it slipped to 2.4735/4775 from 2.4700/4800.
